title: 5 Years Later, Black Clover English Dub Returns for Season 2 Release
content: Black Clover Season 2 has been airing new episodes of the TV anime this Fall, but now fans of the English dub release can finally kick off its return after five long years of waiting for new episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Expands Cast With New Trailers – Watch
content: The Apothecary Diaries is now in the works on its very first feature film outing, and some new teaser trailers are showing off more of the new additions to the expanding cast of characters.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Reveals Devil Union Asta Character Visual
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released a new Devil Union Asta charactel visual following the premiere of Episode 3 on October 17. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. You can see the new visual below.

title: BanG Dream! Releases "God's Blood" from Ave Mujica prima aurora
content: BanG Dream! released a short video of Ave Mujica’s new song “God’s Blood” from the Ave Mujica prima aurora movie. The song is also part of their latest mini-album that is slated to release on October 21. Nichicaline ( BanG Dream! title: New Bleach Final Season Trailer Reveals First Look at Anime Finale After Hiatus – Watch Now
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is soon officially making its return from a month long hiatus for the anime’s final two episodes ever, and now fans have gotten the first look at what to expect from the grand finale with a slick new trailer.
